text: “巴西-中国企业高管对话：新经济下的基础设施”论坛日前在巴西里约热内卢市举行，两国政府、企业和机构人士共同探讨基础设施建设与投资合作机遇。来自巴西国家工业产权局、比亚迪等机构和企业的代表还就经贸合作领域的技术转移、知识产权保护及人工智能等议题展开探讨。 (新华社)
text_en: The "Brazil-China Enterprise Executive Dialogue: Infrastructure in the New Economy" forum was recently held in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, where government, business, and institutional representatives from both countries discussed opportunities for infrastructure construction and investment cooperation. Delegates from the Brazilian National Institute of Industrial Property, BYD, and other institutions and enterprises also discussed topics including technology transfer, intellectual property protection, and artificial intelligence in economic and trade cooperation. (Xinhua News Agency)
